title: Julia Tao
text:
I am a freshly minted PhD in Aerospace Engineering specializing in aircraft systems enegineering. My work bridges rigorous analytical modeling with practical hardware implementation, focusing on high-reliability systems and advanced fluid/thermal architectures.
I am currently seeking full-time roles in R&D, systems engineering, and advanced design, where I can apply my expertise in multi-physics simulation, optimization, and cross-functional problem-solving.
